game_events#ge1.rationale: Sampled KXNHLOVERTIME/KXNHL2OT rules are one sentence with no faceoff definition or postponement clause (KXNHLOT has both); only Kalshi rulebook text or a full listed market can settle this.

game_events#ge2.rationale: Whether a late-tie 'play for the point' effect exists is an open mechanism; play-by-play history is public and ample, so this is unfinished research on whether and how the input belongs, not a data gap.
game_events#ge2.catalog_action: Measure tied-late 5v5 attempt share vs matched earlier tied minutes (10 seasons, stakes interaction) and set the input's role or drop it.

game_events#ge3.rationale: The tied-state hazard input is defined; the limit is that playoff 5v5 overtime offers only a few hundred games, a hard sample-coverage ceiling no research can lift.

game_events#ge4.rationale: The situationCode goalie-in-net encoding is assumed from memory; it is a public field format the author can look up in sample NHL API JSON, so per the strictness rule it is unfinished research.
game_events#ge4.catalog_action: Fetch 2016-17 and 2025-26 NHL API play-by-play JSON, document situationCode digits/values for 6v5 and record per-season coverage.

game_events#ge5.rationale: The record uses an unsourced regulation tie base rate and season drift is not an explicit input; both are authorable from public NHL results, so the catalog definition is incomplete.
game_events#ge5.catalog_action: Compute per-season regulation tie rate since 2005-06 from NHL results, add a drifting tie-rate input tied to league goals/game and cite the table.

game_events#ge6.rationale: The early-penalty share of opening-ten-minute goals is asserted rather than measured, and team-effect reliability is untested; both are measurable from public play-by-play.
game_events#ge6.catalog_action: Estimate split-half reliability of team first-10-minute goal rates and the power-play share of window goals since 2015-16; fix the input as team-specific or league-level.

game_moneyline_puckline#ml1.rationale: KXNHLGAME/KXNHLSPREAD rules only cite the 'official final result' and never state shootout margin scoring; the TOTAL-series +1 clause corroborates but only Kalshi clarification or a settled shootout spread rung confirms.

game_moneyline_puckline#ml3.rationale: Which xG model defines the talent input is unsettled (MoneyPuck vs NST vs Evolving-Hockey differ in features/calibration); the input definition itself is incomplete until a vendor and vintage policy is chosen.
game_moneyline_puckline#ml3.catalog_action: Compare out-of-sample goal-difference prediction of the three public xG vendors over 5 seasons and fix one vendor plus a vintage-recording rule in the input definition.

game_moneyline_puckline#ml4.rationale: Constant vs team-specific home-ice edge (and last-change effect) is a specification choice for the input that public results over 15 seasons can resolve; the catalog has not decided it.
game_moneyline_puckline#ml4.catalog_action: Estimate home goal differential by team with partial pooling over 15 seasons and author the home-edge input as constant, drifting or team-specific accordingly.

game_moneyline_puckline#ml5.rationale: KXNHLSERIES is settled in season_futures; consistency of the per-game win engine across the two records is a catalog authoring cross-check that has not been done.
game_moneyline_puckline#ml5.catalog_action: Cross-check season_futures stage s4 reuses this archetype's per-game win-probability stages s1-s4 (home pattern, goalie volatility) and record the linkage in both entries.

game_moneyline_puckline#ml6.rationale: nhl.lineup_impact_delta lists HockeyViz, which is not a data feed, so the input's source is wrong; the replacement own-RAPM path from shiftcharts is undefined and unchecked.
game_moneyline_puckline#ml6.catalog_action: Replace HockeyViz with an own-RAPM definition from NHL shiftcharts, verify shift intervals on ~20 games and document field coverage and update timing.

game_moneyline_puckline#ml7.rationale: The empty-net conversion probability for one-goal leads late is stated only as an unsourced rough range; it is computable from public play-by-play, so the catalog value is not yet authored.
game_moneyline_puckline#ml7.catalog_action: Estimate from 2015-16+ play-by-play the share of one-goal leads at 3:00 left ending with an empty-net goal, by team/coach and pull time, and cite it in the input.

game_total_and_team_total#tt1.rationale: The gap states no catalog input represents coach tempo and lead-protection style for totals; that is a missing input, closable by authoring and coaching-change research.
game_total_and_team_total#tt1.catalog_action: Author an nhl coach-tempo/lead-protection input and estimate coach fixed effects on attempts and xG using coaching changes as natural experiments.

game_total_and_team_total#tt3.rationale: Referee assignments are published in game summaries; what is missing is the time of first public availability, which can only be learned by timestamped prospective capture of the assignment feed.

game_total_and_team_total#tt4.rationale: Whether total goals need a two-component meltdown mixture beyond pace is an unresolved distributional mechanism; 15 seasons of results allow the test, so the distribution input is unspecified.
game_total_and_team_total#tt4.catalog_action: Compare tail calibration of mixture vs single negative binomial on 15 seasons (9+ goal games) and author the chosen total-goal distribution in the record.

game_total_and_team_total#tt5.rationale: KXNHLSERIESTOTALGOAL moved to playoff_series_aggregate; that record must reuse this per-game total model without shootout credit, an unchecked catalog cross-reference.
game_total_and_team_total#tt5.catalog_action: Cross-check that playoff_series_aggregate composes per-game totals from this archetype's s1-s4 with shootout credit off, and document the dependency in both entries.

game_total_and_team_total#tt6.rationale: Strike ladder beyond sampled rungs, playoff wording and a KXNHLTEAMTOTAL postponement clause are unseen in Kalshi text; the shootout share for the +1 mass is a computable model parameter, not the binding gap.

goalie_saves#gs1.rationale: KXNHLSAVE text says only 'saves recorded' and covers 'active but never enters'; OT/shootout counting and scratched-goalie treatment are not stated and need Kalshi text or settlement precedent.

goalie_saves#gs2.rationale: Pull policy is defined as inferred from past pulls; the constraint is the small number of pulls per coach, a sample-coverage limit rather than a missing definition.

goalie_saves#gs3.rationale: Whether boxscore JSON exposes goalie TOI, shots against and relief-entry time for older seasons is a lookup the author has not done; the input's construction depends on it.
goalie_saves#gs3.catalog_action: Fetch 2016-17 and 2025-26 boxscore and play-by-play JSON, confirm goalie TOI/SA/entry-time fields and specify which endpoint builds the minutes distribution.

goalie_saves#gs4.rationale: The record gives arena SOG recording bias a primary role without checking whether post-2019-20 tracking shrank it; the input's role is unverified with ample public data available.
goalie_saves#gs4.catalog_action: Fit arena random effects on SOG pre- and post-2019-20 and set the venue input's role (primary/secondary/drop) from the result.

offfield_markets#of1.rationale: Expansion awards number a handful in 30 years; any hazard model is coverage-limited by the event count itself, which no research can enlarge.

offfield_markets#of2.rationale: The sampled KXNHLNEXTTEAM window (before Nov 1, 2026) has lapsed; how later windows list and how multiple moves inside one window settle are unknown until Kalshi lists another window.

offfield_markets#of3.rationale: The Board of Governors expansion voting threshold and session timing are assumed from memory; it is a lookup in the NHL constitution/announcements, so per the rules it is unfinished research.
offfield_markets#of3.catalog_action: Look up the NHL constitution / BoG announcements for the expansion approval vote threshold and special-session practice and cite them in the record.

offfield_markets#of4.rationale: Insider-report credibility is defined but no timestamped public archive exists; the history has to be captured prospectively from now on.

offfield_markets#of5.rationale: nhl.gm_candidate_pool and retirement_hazard_profile are defined, but timestamped GM-interview and retirement-statement history has no known archive and needs own capture going forward.

offfield_markets#of6.rationale: KXNHLNEXTTEAM lacks trade-specific inputs (player trade demand, seller/buyer status, deadline timing); these are missing inputs authorable now from past deadlines.
offfield_markets#of6.catalog_action: Author seller-status, trade-request and deadline-timing inputs for KXNHLNEXTTEAM and map the Retires/No Team and re-sign outcomes from the sampled rules text.

offfield_markets#of7.rationale: KXNHLNEXTGM is silent on interim/acting titles and post-deadline effective dates; KXNHLRETIRE on reversed retirements and who must announce; only Kalshi clarification or precedent resolves this.

parlay_combo#pc1.rationale: No NHL combo/parlay series exists in the ledger, so leg-void treatment, structure and leg count have no Kalshi text at all; resolvable only when Kalshi lists one.

parlay_combo#pc2.rationale: How Kalshi prices multivariate combos (RFQ, market maker) is documented by Kalshi publicly and has not been read; this is a lookup, not a data limitation.
parlay_combo#pc2.catalog_action: Read Kalshi's multivariate/combo market documentation and API docs, record the quoting mechanism and whether price history is retrievable.

parlay_combo#pc3.rationale: Copula family and tail-dependence stability for win/total/points legs are untested modelling choices with ample history; the dependence input is unspecified (conditional on pc5).
parlay_combo#pc3.catalog_action: Compare joint log-likelihood of candidate copula families over rolling seasons and author the dependence input's family and stability check.

parlay_combo#pc4.rationale: Joint lineup state at combo trade time is defined; measuring the gap needs archived lineup vintages vs trading windows, which must be captured prospectively.

parlay_combo#pc5.rationale: Whether NHL combos are same-game or cross-game collections is unknowable without a listed Kalshi NHL combo series and its rules text.

period_markets#pm1.rationale: KXNHL1PBTTS is in the sample with no markets or rules text; own-goal and per-team counting cannot be read until Kalshi lists it.

period_markets#pm2.rationale: Whether referees balance penalties within a game is an unresolved mechanism the period-penalty input depends on; 15 seasons of public penalty data can resolve it.
period_markets#pm2.catalog_action: Estimate the lagged penalty-differential coefficient with crew random effects on 15 seasons and author the input's role from the result.

period_markets#pm3.rationale: That shiftcharts give the first-shift line and reliable opening deployment is unchecked; it is a public payload lookup that determines the input's construction.
period_markets#pm3.catalog_action: Pull sample NHL shiftcharts payloads, confirm first-shift player identification and document the field and its coverage by season.

period_markets#pm4.rationale: The long-change input is defined; team-level second-period estimates are capped by ~80 games per team-season, a sample-coverage limit.

period_markets#pm6.rationale: A period-specific rest/fatigue fade beyond the backup-goalie channel is unestablished; public team-period data can test it, so the input's inclusion is undecided.
period_markets#pm6.catalog_action: Estimate the period-by-rest interaction on 2015-16+ team-period data with goalie identity controlled and keep or drop the input accordingly.

period_markets#pm7.rationale: Remaining gap is unchecked claims that Hockey-Reference and the NHL API give period scoring with running score for older seasons, a lookup the author can do (title-only KXNHL1PBTTS is pm1).
period_markets#pm7.catalog_action: Sample period score fields from 2015-16 and 2025-26 NHL API boxscores and Hockey-Reference pages and document coverage in the input source.

period_markets#pm8.rationale: Recovered period rules cover pre-start postponement only; settlement of a game suspended after puck drop is absent from Kalshi text and needs Kalshi rulebook wording.

player_h2h#hh1.rationale: No NHL head-to-head series is listed, so tie, stat and non-playing rules have no Kalshi text; the archetype is provisional until one lists.

player_h2h#hh2.rationale: Pair dependence inputs are defined; same-line pair samples are small and lines churn, a coverage limit handled by pooling by slot type.

player_h2h#hh3.rationale: Whether opposed-script negative correlation exists for SOG beyond shared pace is an open mechanism testable on public data; the dependence input's need is undecided.
player_h2h#hh3.catalog_action: Estimate correlation of opposing players' SOG residuals conditional on team volume across seasons and author or drop the opposed-script term.

player_h2h#hh4.rationale: PP-unit projections exist (Daily Faceoff) but their accuracy and timing can only be judged by capturing projections with timestamps and comparing to shift-derived units going forward.

player_h2h#hh5.rationale: Whether H2H pairs are same-game or cross-game is unstated because no series exists; only Kalshi listing a series resolves the event definition.

player_h2h#hh6.rationale: ipp_by_state and sog_share_on_ice cite play-by-play for on-ice skaters, which it likely lacks; the input's source/construction (shiftchart join) is wrong or undefined.
player_h2h#hh6.catalog_action: Pull one play-by-play JSON plus shiftcharts, test on-ice reconstruction at event times, document join accuracy and rewrite the input source accordingly.

player_points_goals_assists#pp1.rationale: KXNHLANYGOAL has no markets or rules text and the ladder rules do not state OT/empty-net counting; Kalshi text or a settled OT/EN market is required.

player_points_goals_assists#pp3.rationale: On-ice skater ids and goalie-pulled state in play-by-play since 2012-13 are unconfirmed; this is a field lookup that decides how IPP and on-ice xG inputs are built.
player_points_goals_assists#pp3.catalog_action: Download play-by-play from several seasons since 2012-13, confirm on-ice/goalie-pulled fields or define the shiftchart join, and update the input sources.

player_points_goals_assists#pp4.rationale: Ladder rules name no source of truth or scoring-correction cut-off; only Kalshi wording or observed settlements around scoring changes can settle it.

player_points_goals_assists#pp5.rationale: 'Active' is undefined and healthy-scratch/pre-game-out treatment is not stated in KXNHLGOAL/PTS/AST text; requires Kalshi clarification or settlement precedent.

player_shots_on_goal#sg1.rationale: No Kalshi skater-SOG series exists, so settlement is inferred from sibling ladders; only a listed series' rules text can confirm it.

player_shots_on_goal#sg2.rationale: Per-player SOG and shot events with shooter/on-ice players since 2012-13 are assumed, not checked; a public endpoint lookup the author can perform.
player_shots_on_goal#sg2.catalog_action: Pull boxscore and play-by-play samples from several seasons since 2012-13 and document per-player SOG and shot-event fields and coverage.

player_shots_on_goal#sg3.rationale: Arena SOG recording bias after tracking is unmeasured, so whether the venue input matters is undecided; public data over pre/post 2019-20 can settle it.
player_shots_on_goal#sg3.catalog_action: Estimate arena random effect on SOG separately pre- and post-2019-20 and set the venue input's role for skater SOG.

player_shots_on_goal#sg4.rationale: Shot-lane and defender tracking data are held by paid vendors (Sportlogiq, Stats Perform); the input is defined but its source is paid/inaccessible from here.

player_shots_on_goal#sg5.rationale: sog_share_on_ice and opp_sog_for_rate need on-ice skater lists the play-by-play likely lacks; the input construction via shiftchart/HTML TOI join is undefined.
player_shots_on_goal#sg5.catalog_action: Pull a play-by-play JSON and matching shiftcharts, test on-ice reconstruction at shot times, record join success and rewrite both inputs' sources.

season_awards_and_stats#aw1.rationale: Only a Finals KXNHLPLAYOFFGOALS market is sampled; whether earlier-round leaderboards span all series and how rescinded goals are handled needs Kalshi rules for an earlier round.

season_awards_and_stats#aw10.rationale: The Art Ross tiebreak is from memory and a contract reading is authorable: 'wins the Trophy' follows the league's award, with 1/N only for co-awarded honours like a shared Richard.
season_awards_and_stats#aw10.catalog_action: Confirm the Art Ross tiebreak order on NHL.com and author the reading that 1/N applies only when the league itself shares the award (Richard), noting residual Kalshi risk.

season_awards_and_stats#aw2.rationale: The Jack Adams voting body, ballot timing and eligibility of fired coaches are facts from memory that the NHL award description and past winners can confirm.
season_awards_and_stats#aw2.catalog_action: Look up the Jack Adams voting body, ballot timing and any mid-season-firing eligibility precedent on NHL.com and cite them in the record.

season_awards_and_stats#aw4.rationale: Voter weighting of narrative vs over-performance is defined as a model term; the constraint is a small history of winners/finalists per award, a coverage limit.

season_awards_and_stats#aw5.rationale: KXNHLMVP is in the sample with no rules text or markets and duplicates KXNHLHART by title; whether it is the Hart, another vote or a retired series is knowable only from Kalshi text.

season_awards_and_stats#aw7.rationale: No mapping from coach expectation delta to a win probability among ~30 coaches is specified (award model is player-only), and preseason-projection history is unchecked.
season_awards_and_stats#aw7.catalog_action: Author a coach-level conditional-logit input for Jack Adams on the expectation delta and inventory 10+ seasons of preseason point projections as its source.

season_awards_and_stats#aw8.rationale: Lindsay electorate/ballot facts are from memory and the fallback model for finalist-only data is unspecified; both are authorable even though vote totals may be unpublished.
season_awards_and_stats#aw8.catalog_action: Check NHLPA/NHL.com for Lindsay vote totals and electorate rules; if absent, author a rank-ordered finalist/winner model as the Lindsay input.

season_awards_and_stats#aw9.rationale: The finalist-only vote-share regression with 8+ covariates is mis-specified (overfit-prone, selected sample, no voter narrative term); the catalog specification is wrong, not just data-thin.
season_awards_and_stats#aw9.catalog_action: Respecify the award vote-share input on all vote-receiving players where published, 3-4 covariates, leave-one-season-out validation, and a voter narrative term.

season_futures#sf1.rationale: KXNHL, conference, playoff, series and 4 Nations rules are one sentence, silent on cancelled seasons, unfinished series and dead heats; needs Kalshi rulebook text or precedent.

season_futures#sf10.rationale: The national-roster strength input is defined; only a handful of best-on-best tournaments in differing formats exist, a hard coverage limit on calibration.

season_futures#sf11.rationale: Residual streakiness beyond strength drives the longest-streak tail but is not estimated; 20 seasons of public results allow it, so the input is unspecified.
season_futures#sf11.catalog_action: Estimate lag-k residual result correlation over 20 seasons, compare simulated league max streaks with history, and author the streak-dependence input.

season_futures#sf2.rationale: No input represents coach quality or coaching changes as a team-strength driver; a missing input that coaching-change research can define.
season_futures#sf2.catalog_action: Author a coach-effect input and estimate mid-season coaching-change effects on team rating to decide its adjustment size.

season_futures#sf3.rationale: The playoff officiating regime is only a flag with no quantified input; penalty/PP differences in playoffs are measurable from public data.
season_futures#sf3.catalog_action: Quantify playoff vs regular-season penalty and PP rates and their effect on series outcomes, and author a playoff-officiating input with that effect.

season_futures#sf4.rationale: KXNHLRECORDWORST explicitly applies league tiebreakers; the NHL tiebreak order is public and simply not yet looked up and authored.
season_futures#sf4.catalog_action: Look up the NHL standings tiebreak order (RW, ROW, W, H2H, goal diff...) and author how it applies to worst-record and Presidents' Trophy ties.

season_futures#sf5.rationale: The preseason-prior weight at ~14 games is unestimated though it sets injected rating uncertainty; 15 seasons of public results can backtest it.
season_futures#sf5.catalog_action: Backtest prior weight at game 14 across 15 seasons on out-of-sample points/qualification and fix the rating-uncertainty input from it.

season_futures#sf6.rationale: Draft-lottery tanking incentives are explicitly not an input to KXNHLRECORDWORST; a missing mechanism measurable from past bottom-five teams.
season_futures#sf6.catalog_action: Add a tanking input linked to nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing and measure post-deadline points shortfall of bottom-five teams vs rating.

season_futures#sf7.rationale: Same mis-specified finalist-only vote-share regression as aw9 (carried there); the catalog's award model specification is wrong, not merely data-thin.
season_futures#sf7.catalog_action: Respecify per aw9: cap covariates at 3-4, leave-one-season-out validation over 20 seasons, report calibration before use.

season_futures#sf8.rationale: Duplicate of aw10: whether league tiebreak precedes 1/N for Art Ross/Richard is an authorable contract reading plus a lookup of the Art Ross tiebreak.
season_futures#sf8.catalog_action: Resolve jointly with aw10: confirm Art Ross tiebreak on NHL.com and author the 'league award decides, 1/N only if co-awarded' reading.

season_futures#sf9.rationale: Division-winner series have empty secondary rules and KXNHLWSTREAK does not say whether OT/SO wins extend streaks; only Kalshi wording or settlement precedent resolves it.

unreg:draft_selection#d1.rationale: KXNHLDRAFTPICK/DRAFTTOP give only the YES condition (empty secondary text): no source of truth, forfeited-slot or postponement handling; needs Kalshi rulebook text.

unreg:draft_selection#d2.rationale: Lottery mechanics (draws, max rise, repeat-win limits) are quoted from general knowledge; the league's current procedure is public and should be looked up.
unreg:draft_selection#d2.catalog_action: Read the NHL's current draft lottery procedure and verify each rule against the latest lottery results; cite it in nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing.

unreg:draft_selection#d3.rationale: Club internal draft boards are private; the input is defined via public rankings and past picks, and the true source is inaccessible.

unreg:draft_selection#d4.rationale: The need-vs-best-available effect by slot band is contested and unestimated; public historical drafts allow measurement, so the input's role is undecided.
unreg:draft_selection#d4.catalog_action: Estimate the team-need coefficient by slot band on historical drafts and set nhl.draft_team_need_profile's role (or drop it in the top five).

unreg:draft_selection#d5.rationale: The rule ordering playoff clubs in slots 17-28 is from memory; the NHL draft-order procedure is public and checkable against 2024-26 orders.
unreg:draft_selection#d5.catalog_action: Read the NHL draft-order procedure for slots 17-28 and verify against the 2024-2026 first-round orders; author the rule in the record.

unreg:draft_selection#d6.rationale: Board inputs are defined; multi-service ranking history is paywalled (McKeen's, FC Hockey, EP guide) or patchy pre-2010, limiting the calibration window.

unreg:draft_selection#d7.rationale: insider_report_credibility is defined but draft-week reports lack a public archive; scoring needs timestamped capture over several future drafts.

unreg:draft_selection#d8.rationale: Pick-condition history lost its main free source when CapFriendly shut in July 2024; PuckPedia/Wayback coverage is the remaining, unverified source.

unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p1.rationale: Sampled series rules (empty secondary text) name no source of truth, OT-goal counting or unfinished-series handling; requires Kalshi rulebook or a settled precedent.

unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p2.rationale: Within-series dependence and elimination-state effects are defined inputs; 0-3 states and playoff samples are tiny, a coverage limit on estimation.

unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p3.rationale: Empty-net and pulled-goalie timing coverage back to 2010 in free endpoints is assumed, not checked; a public field lookup the author can perform.
unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p3.catalog_action: Pull sample play-by-play/shift data from several seasons since 2010 and document which empty-net/pulled-goalie fields are populated per season.

unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p4.rationale: Modelling KXNHL30COMEBACK via bracket simulation here is an unconfirmed catalog assignment; the plural KXNHLSERIESTOTALGOALS is in the rules sample as NO_MARKETS_LISTED.
unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p4.catalog_action: Confirm KXNHL30COMEBACK is owned here with a bracket-union simulation stage and record KXNHLSERIESTOTALGOALS as a no-markets duplicate in the ledger.

unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p5.rationale: No playoff-specific starter-change hazard is defined; goalie_start_forecast relies on regular-season rotation rules, so a needed input is missing.
unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p5.catalog_action: Author a playoff starter-change hazard input and estimate P(change after sub-threshold save % game) from 2005-06+ playoff boxscores.

unreg:team_and_player_season_counting#sc.rationale: Player-total rules state no minimum games, trade/retirement or correction cut-off clauses (empty secondary text); needs fuller Kalshi rules from both goal series.
The 'All-NHL team' contract type has no live series or rules text; its definition depends entirely on Kalshi listing it, not on data.
The finishing shrinkage constant moves 40+/60+ goal tails and is unestimated; split-half reliability is computable from public shot data, so the input is not yet specified.
unreg:team_and_player_season_counting#sc.catalog_action: Estimate split-half reliability of goals minus ixG for forwards with 500+ shots and set nhl.finishing's shrinkage constant from it.

unreg:team_and_player_season_counting#sc.rationale: That shootout goals are excluded from official player goal totals is assumed from league practice; it is a lookup in any shootout game's NHL stats.
unreg:team_and_player_season_counting#sc.catalog_action: Check NHL stats for a shootout game to confirm shootout goals are excluded from player goals and cite it in the settlement reading.

unreg:team_and_player_season_counting#sc.rationale: The games-played hazard input is defined; the NHL has no official injury feed and detailed injury history is paid (Man Games Lost) or scraped.
